column1: # Classic SACA-benchmark corpora: uint8 byte streams, no tokenizer.
# The URL list is DATA, not code, because these hosts rot. Pizza&Chili has moved
# and been down for long stretches, and mattmahoney.net has shifted between
# http/https/www with an expired cert at times. `url` holds |-separated
# alternates tried left to right, first HTTP 200 wins, so a dead mirror is a
# one-token edit rather than a code change.
# Columns
#   label         output name; $ROOT/<label>/<label>[-<post>].u8
#   url           |-separated alternates
#   archive       gz | zip | 7z | tar.gz | none
#   member        member inside a zip/7z/tar archive; - otherwise
#   post          - | fasta2seq | fasta2acgt   (see below)
#   expect_bytes  uncompressed artifact size; - if not yet known
#   sha256_dl     hash of the downloaded archive; - until recorded
#   sha256_out    hash of the final .u8; - until recorded  <- the citable one
# Two hash columns on purpose: sha256_dl proves the mirror served the same
# bytes, sha256_out proves the decompression AND post-processing match. Only
# sha256_out describes what the SACA actually consumes.
# post= is the byte-stream analogue of the tokenizer tag. A FASTA is not a byte
# stream -- it carries headers, hard newlines every 60 chars, N runs, and (for
# UCSC) soft-masked lowercase repeats -- so the transform is part of the
# artifact's identity and goes in the filename:
#   fasta2seq   strip headers + newlines, uppercase, keep N   (sigma ~5-12)
#   fasta2acgt  additionally drop N                           (sigma 4)
# PROBED 2026-09-12: all 13 URLs answer 200 on their FIRST alternate. The
# Pizza&Chili category names guessed here (nlang, dna, protein, code, xml) are
# all correct, and dcc.uchile.cl is up -- the di.unipi.it alternates are kept as
# fallbacks but were not needed. One correction was required: the per-chromosome
# genome lives at goldenPath/hg38/chromosomes/, not under bigZips/.
# Compressed download sizes observed (Content-Range), total ~2.4 GB:
#   rep-einstein-en      320,696     rep-cere           5,241,219
# The repetitive entries are tiny compressed and large expanded -- einstein.en
# is 320 KB of 7z for ~446 MB of text. That ratio IS the corpus's point, and it
# is why these matter to a prefix-doubling study more than another 100B tokens.
# UCSC also publishes goldenPath/hg38/bigZips/md5sum.txt (confirmed present): a
# first-party checksum for hg38.fa.gz, so sha256_dl is not the only integrity
# check available there.
# expect_bytes below is still UNCOMPRESSED and mostly unfilled -- it can only be
# recorded after a real fetch. enwik8/9 are the exception: their sizes are
# definitional, so those two are hard assertions from the start.
#label
# --- enwik8/9: sizes are DEFINITIONAL (first 1e8 / 1e9 bytes of a Wikipedia
# --- dump), so expect_bytes is a hard assertion, not a guess. Host is the
# --- uncertain part, hence three alternates.
enwik8
enwik9
# --- Pizza&Chili standard collection. Category directories and .gz serving
# --- both CONFIRMED by the probe. english is the full 2.1 GB text;
# --- english.1024MB is the truncated variant most published numbers use, so
# --- carry both -- comparability to the literature depends on which one.
pc-english
pc-english-1024
pc-dna
pc-proteins
pc-sources
pc-dblp
# --- Pizza&Chili REPETITIVE corpus. Worth more to the prefix-doubling study
# --- than another 100B tokens: decay rate is governed by repeat depth, and
# --- this is the only source of graded, real repetitiveness (the deduplicated
# --- Pile has had exactly that removed). einstein.en is a real-text worst
# --- case; cere is a small-alphabet one.
# --- Needs a 7z reader (7z, 7za or bsdtar). Without one, pip install py7zr
# --- into the venv, or use the repcorpus.tar.gz bundle.
rep-einstein-en
rep-cere
rep-kernel
# --- Genome. UCSC ships md5sum.txt in the same directory: a first-party
# --- checksum, use it. If Ensembl is substituted, PIN the release number --
# --- current_fasta is a moving alias and destroys citability.
# --- hg38 is soft-masked (lowercase repeats), so fasta2seq uppercases; expect
# --- sigma ~5 rather than the ~12 an unconverted soft-masked stream gives.
hg38
hg38-chr1
